content: The Triangle STAND ALONE .  A book about the triangle, Sean is drawn towards it after the disappearance of his parents 10 years before NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  Finds out the triangle was created by humans after an accident  It created a  parrellel  world that they have been monitoring and experimenting with  Sean has to save his reality when, the institute in the “real” world threatens to shut down the experiment and destroy the parallel world.
